note: Why this kernel neither permits nor forbids scope widening.
why: A predicate declaring reads:[state,world] evaluated inside a trace context may see a world snapshot taken at a different logical step than the state it judges. §6.1.2 rule 2 requires reproducibility; the pairing of surfaces to logical steps is never pinned.
expected: Same predicate, same state, DIFFERENT world snapshot — both are legal evaluations under the text as written. Reproducibility is a claim about a pairing the RFC does not pin.
